id: 05_Health Physics Lecture 4 Field Dosimetry Measuring Radiation Levels & Individual
title: 现场剂量测量：辐射水平与个人剂量跟踪
source_doc: course/Health Physics & Nuclear Medicine/05_Health Physics Lecture 4 Field Dosimetry Measuring Radiation Levels & Individual.md
author_source: project/Health Physics & Nuclear Medicine/05_Health Physics Lecture 4 Field Dosimetry Measuring Radiation Levels & Individual/src.py

points.K5: 局限二：忙不过来会漏数
points.K12: 从区域监测到个人追踪

shots.scene: 欣欣一手拿着便携巡测仪，一手举着一支笔形剂量计，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a handheld survey meter in one paw and raises a pen-shaped pocket dosimeter in the other, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，学怎样在现场测辐射。
overlay: 现场剂量测量：测环境，也测自己

shots.scene: 两个图标并排：一个房间、一个人形，中间一台仪器
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side, a room and a human figure, with a handheld meter in between. No people.
shots.narration: 既要测环境，也要测自己。

shots.scene: 核物理实验室，老李请阿杰在实验结束后巡测一遍房间
shots.prompt_en: In a nuclear physics teaching lab after an experiment, the facility engineer hands the young male student a handheld survey meter and gestures around the room.
shots.narration: 实验结束，老李让阿杰测一遍房间。

shots.scene: 阿杰随手拿起一台计数器，屏幕数字很小，他满意地点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a handheld counter, glances at a blank display showing a low reading, and nods with satisfaction.
shots.narration: 读数很低，阿杰说：没事了。

shots.scene: 小研戴着剂量计走过来，皱眉指着仪器侧面空白的标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a dosimeter badge, walks over and frowns, pointing at a blank calibration label on the side of the meter.
shots.narration: 小研问：这台仪器校准过吗？

shots.scene: 小研又指着阿杰空荡荡的胸前口袋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the young male student's empty chest pocket where a dosimeter should be.
shots.narration: 你的剂量计呢？

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，面露尴尬
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking embarrassed.
shots.narration: 阿杰愣住了：测量还有这么多讲究？

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们就从现场测量讲起。

shots.scene: 实验台旁，小研戴着剂量计，手持巡测仪在测量
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a dosimeter badge and gloves, holds a survey meter near a lab bench.
shots.narration: 现场剂量测量，就是在工作现场实测。

shots.scene: 两个人形图标，一个指向自己，一个指向别人
shots.prompt_en: Two simple human icons: one pointing at itself, one pointing at another figure, both with small dosimeter badges. No people.
shots.narration: 测别人受了多少，也测自己受了多少。

shots.scene: 实验课上用过的探测器图标和现场仪器图标之间连一条线
shots.prompt_en: A line connecting a lab detector setup icon on the left to a portable field meter icon on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 用到的，正是实验课里学过的探测器。

shots.scene: 一个房间轮廓，里面浮着许多小光点，一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: A room outline filled with tiny floating light dots and a big question mark above it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一个问题：这里有多少辐射？

shots.scene: 盖革计数器和电离室两台仪器图标
shots.prompt_en: Two instrument icons: a handheld counter with a long probe, and a boxy chamber-style survey meter. No people.
shots.narration: 用盖革计数器或电离室来回答。

shots.scene: 一个人形图标，胸前口袋插着一支笔，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: A human figure icon with a pen-shaped dosimeter in the chest pocket and a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第二个问题：这个人受了多少？

shots.scene: 小研低头看白大褂口袋里的笔形剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks down at the pen-shaped pocket dosimeter clipped in her lab coat pocket.
shots.narration: 口袋里这支笔，就是个人剂量计。

shots.scene: 便携式计数器：主机盒、电缆、长探头棒
shots.prompt_en: A portable radiation counter: a compact main box with a blank display, a coiled cable and a long cylindrical probe. No people.
shots.narration: 便携式盖革计数器，带一根探头。

shots.scene: 探头棒剖面，射线进入，里面闪出一道火花，变成一个脉冲
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of the probe tube: a ray enters, a small spark cascade flashes inside the gas, and a single pulse travels down the cable. No people.
shots.narration: 射线进管，气体放大成一个电脉冲。

shots.scene: 主机屏幕上的数字一下下往上跳
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the main box display with blank digits ticking upward. No people.
shots.narration: 主机数脉冲，显示计数率。

shots.scene: 电池图标和结实的外壳，仪器被带到户外
shots.prompt_en: A battery icon and a rugged meter case; the meter is carried along an outdoor path. No people.
shots.narration: 简单、结实、用电池，方便带到现场。

shots.scene: 实验室台面上固定的计数装置与手提仪器并排
shots.prompt_en: A fixed counting setup on a lab bench next to a handheld portable counter. No people.
shots.narration: 和实验室里固定的装置不一样。

shots.scene: 一扇关着的门，门外传来敲门声的波纹
shots.prompt_en: A closed door with sound ripples showing knocking from the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 门关着，只听见有人敲门。

shots.scene: 门外的影子：小狗、大人、小孩轮流出现，问号
shots.prompt_en: Behind a frosted door, silhouettes of a dog, an adult and a child appear one after another, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 却不知道门外是谁。

shots.scene: α、β、γ三个图标进入计数管，出来的脉冲一模一样
shots.prompt_en: Three different ray icons enter the counter tube, and three identical pulses come out. No people.
shots.narration: 盖革计数器分不清α、β、γ。

shots.scene: 能量高低不同的两条射线，读数相同，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: A strong ray and a weak ray enter the tube and produce the same pulse, with a question mark beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 也分不清射线能量高低。

shots.section_title: 局限二：忙不过来会漏数
shots.scene: 收银台前，一个店员正在结账，后面排起长队
shots.prompt_en: A single cashier counter with one clerk icon busy scanning while a long queue of customers waits. No people.
shots.narration: 一个脉冲要处理一会儿。
overlay: 局限二：忙不过来会漏数

shots.section_title: 局限二：忙不过来会漏数
shots.scene: 处理期间又来的射线被挡在外面，打着灰色问号
shots.prompt_en: While the tube is busy, newly arriving rays bounce off and fade into gray question marks. No people.
shots.narration: 这段死时间里，再来的射线不计。

shots.section_title: 局限二：忙不过来会漏数
shots.scene: 源离计数器远时，计数稀疏；放近时，射线密密麻麻
shots.prompt_en: Side-by-side panels: a source far from the counter with sparse rays, and a source close to it with dense rays. No people.
shots.narration: 源越近、射线越多，漏掉越多。

shots.section_title: 局限二：忙不过来会漏数
shots.scene: 仪表指针偏低，旁边亮起警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A meter needle reading low while a yellow warning triangle glows beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 强场里，它会低报真实危险。

shots.section_title: 局限二：忙不过来会漏数
shots.scene: 天平一边是完整的脉冲信息，一边是漏掉的计数
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with one clean pulse icon on one side and a few greyed-out missed pulses on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 这是为保住信号做的必要牺牲。

shots.scene: 一个中子小球撞向计数管，弹开，旁边一个划掉的眼睛
shots.prompt_en: A small neutron ball bounces off the counter tube, with a crossed-out eye icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 盖革计数器对中子基本看不见。

shots.scene: γ射线和带电粒子图标打绿勾，中子图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A gamma ray icon and a charged particle icon with green checks, and a neutron icon with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 它主要用来测γ射线和带电粒子。

shots.scene: 校准证书图标上只有γ和带电粒子，中子一栏空着
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer swaps in a different, larger dedicated meter at a doorway with an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 它没有针对中子做过校准。

shots.scene: 一台方盒式电离室巡测仪
shots.prompt_en: A boxy ionization chamber survey meter with a blank dial. No people.
shots.narration: 再看电离室巡测仪。

shots.scene: 上方是一串尖尖的脉冲，下方是一条平滑的电流线
shots.prompt_en: Top: a row of sharp identical spikes; bottom: a smooth continuous wavy line. No people.
shots.narration: 它不数脉冲，测的是连续的电流。

shots.scene: 仪表指针稳稳指向一个刻度，旁边小钟
shots.prompt_en: The meter needle points steadily on a blank scale, with a small clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 直接读出剂量率。

shots.scene: 一把很长的尺子横跨低、高两端，全程打勾
shots.prompt_en: A very long ruler spanning from a small dot to a big dot, with green checks along its length. No people.
shots.narration: 量程宽，读数准。

shots.scene: 台面上一点点污染小斑点，电离室指针几乎不动
shots.prompt_en: A few tiny contamination specks on a bench; the ionization chamber needle barely moves. No people.
shots.narration: 但不够灵敏，找微量污染不合适。

shots.scene: 左边盖革计数器在台面上找小斑点，右边电离室在房间中央测剂量率
shots.prompt_en: Split panel: on the left a counter probe sweeps a bench to find tiny specks; on the right a chamber meter measures in the middle of a room. No people.
shots.narration: 盖革找污染，电离室测剂量率。

shots.scene: 盖革计数器旁一个大放大镜，电离室旁一个稳稳的天平
shots.prompt_en: A big magnifying glass beside the counter, and a steady balance scale beside the chamber meter. No people.
shots.narration: 盖革灵敏，电离室准确。

shots.scene: 强辐射场图标前，盖革图标冒汗，电离室图标稳稳站着
shots.prompt_en: In front of a strong radiation field icon, the counter icon sweats nervously while the chamber icon stands calmly. No people.
shots.narration: 强场里，电离室更可靠。

shots.scene: 电离室旁一条平坦的响应曲线
shots.prompt_en: Beside the chamber meter, a nearly flat response line across low and high energies. No people.
shots.narration: 电离室能量分辨高，剂量当量准。

shots.scene: 小研在空白笔记本上给对比表画星号
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws a star next to a blank comparison table in her notebook.
shots.narration: 这张对比表，可能会考到。

shots.scene: 一颗发光的小点源，周围一圈圈光环
shots.prompt_en: A small glowing point source with concentric rings of light around it. No people.
shots.narration: 测量之前，可以先估一估。

shots.scene: 大桶小桶的发光弹珠，表示源强弱
shots.prompt_en: A big bucket and a small bucket of glowing marbles. No people.
shots.narration: 源越强，剂量率越高。

shots.scene: 两条射线，一条粗亮，一条细弱
shots.prompt_en: Two rays from a source: one thick and bright, one thin and faint. No people.
shots.narration: 每次衰变放出的γ能量越高，也越高。

shots.scene: 人形图标从源旁后退一步，地上光斑变淡成四分之一
shots.prompt_en: A stick figure steps back from a source; the light patch on the floor spreads and becomes four times fainter. No people.
shots.narration: 距离加倍，剂量率降到四分之一。

shots.scene: 几个不同的源罐，各有不同的小图标
shots.prompt_en: Several different small source containers, each with a different simple symbol on its lid. No people.
shots.narration: 每种核素，还有自己的常数可查。

shots.scene: 一张空白卡片上画着源、能量、距离三个图标和分数线
shots.prompt_en: A blank card with a source icon, an energy icon and a distance icon arranged as a simple fraction. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量率约等于6乘活度乘γ能量除以距离平方

shots.scene: 学生看着墙上空白的考试时间表，翻开对应的课本
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks a blank exam timetable on the wall, then opens the matching textbook.
shots.narration: 考试前，先看清考哪一科。

shots.scene: 仪器旁一个能量刻度条，上面圈出一段
shots.prompt_en: Beside a survey meter, an energy scale bar with one segment circled. No people.
shots.narration: 测量前，确认仪器对这个能量校准过。

shots.scene: 用高能源校准的计数器去测低能射线，读数一高一低地乱跳
shots.prompt_en: A counter calibrated with a high-energy source is pointed at a low-energy source; its needle swings too high, then too low. No people.
shots.narration: 用钴60校准，测低能光子会过响应或欠响应。

shots.scene: 低能射线和高能射线与物质作用方式不同的示意
shots.prompt_en: Two rays of different energy hitting atoms: the low-energy ray gets swallowed often, the high-energy ray mostly passes through. No people.
shots.narration: 光电效应截面，随能量变化很大。

shots.scene: 探头外加一层补偿外套，响应曲线变平
shots.prompt_en: A probe gets a thin compensating sleeve, and its response curve flattens out. No people.
shots.narration: 办法是用能量补偿探头。

shots.scene: 小研在点源前近处放一台仪器测量
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a dosimeter badge and gloves, places a meter close to a small sealed source holder with long tongs nearby.
shots.narration: 现场还能验证平方反比。

shots.scene: 同一台仪器移到两倍远处，再读一次
shots.prompt_en: The same meter is moved to twice the distance and read again; two blank reading cards on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 在两个距离各测一次。

shots.scene: 两个读数卡之间一个等号，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Two blank reading cards with an equals sign between them and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 比值符合距离平方，就对上了。

shots.scene: 旁边墙面反射出波纹，被打问号
shots.prompt_en: Wavy reflections bouncing off a nearby wall, marked with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 对不上，可能有散射或源不是点源。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本空白的实验手册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a blank lab manual and smiles.
shots.narration: 这曾是硕士一年级的实验。

shots.section_title: 从区域监测到个人追踪
shots.scene: 房间俯视图，几个区域涂着不同深浅
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a room with zones shaded in different intensities. No people.
shots.narration: 区域监测，给出房间的整体情况。
overlay: 从区域监测到个人追踪

shots.section_title: 从区域监测到个人追踪
shots.scene: 阿杰在房间里走动，一会儿靠近源，一会儿远离
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks around the lab, sometimes near the shielded source area and sometimes far away, wearing a dosimeter badge.
shots.narration: 可人在走动，离源远近一直在变。

shots.section_title: 从区域监测到个人追踪
shots.scene: 钟表和脚印图标
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon and a trail of footprints. No people.
shots.narration: 停留多久，也一直在变。

shots.section_title: 从区域监测到个人追踪
shots.scene: 胸前剂量计图标旁，一个向上累加的柱子
shots.prompt_en: A dosimeter icon on a chest with a bar beside it that grows step by step. No people.
shots.narration: 所以要实时记录每个人的累计剂量。

shots.scene: 一支笔形剂量计放大，看起来像钢笔
shots.prompt_en: A large pen-shaped pocket dosimeter that looks like an ordinary fountain pen. No people.
shots.narration: 这支笔不是写字用的。

shots.scene: 笔身剖开，里面是一个充气小腔
shots.prompt_en: The pen body cut open, revealing a sealed small gas-filled chamber inside. No people.
shots.narration: 笔身是密封的小电离室，充着气。

shots.scene: 腔内两根电极之间悬着一根极细的丝
shots.prompt_en: Inside the chamber, an ultra-thin fiber hangs between two electrodes. No people.
shots.narration: 里面悬着一根极细的石英丝。

shots.scene: 一端是放大目镜和空白刻度，另一端是充电触点
shots.prompt_en: One end has a small magnifying eyepiece with a blank scale; the other end has a charging contact pin. No people.
shots.narration: 一头是目镜刻度，一头是充电触点。

shots.scene: 剂量计插在充电座上，石英丝弹到零位
shots.prompt_en: The pen dosimeter sits on a small charger base; inside, the fiber swings to the zero end of a blank scale. No people.
shots.narration: 先充电，同种电荷相斥，丝偏到零。

shots.scene: 射线进入笔身，腔内气体冒出小正负号
shots.prompt_en: Wavy rays enter the pen; tiny plus and minus signs pop up in the gas inside. No people.
shots.narration: 射线电离气体，中和掉一部分电荷。

shots.scene: 石英丝慢慢向刻度另一边移动
shots.prompt_en: The fiber slowly drifts across the blank scale. No people.
shots.narration: 电场变弱，丝就慢慢移过去。

shots.scene: 小研把剂量计对着窗户的光，从目镜看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the pen dosimeter up toward a bright window and looks through the eyepiece.
shots.narration: 对着光一看，就知道累计受了多少。

shots.scene: 笔形剂量计打绿勾，旁边一个冲洗暗盒打了个时钟
shots.prompt_en: The pen dosimeter with a green check, next to a film processing box with a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 当场读数，不用送去冲洗。

shots.scene: 剂量计上方的刻度条，各型号范围不同
shots.prompt_en: Several pen dosimeters with scales of different lengths. No people.
shots.narration: 量程看型号，如0到200毫伦或0到5毫希。

shots.scene: 能量刻度条从低端到高端亮起一大段
shots.prompt_en: An energy scale bar with a long middle section glowing, from a low mark to a high mark. No people.
shots.narration: 能量响应约从25千电子伏到几兆电子伏。

shots.scene: 靶心图标周围一圈误差环
shots.prompt_en: A target icon with a narrow error ring around the bullseye. No people.
shots.narration: 准确度约正负10%到15%。

shots.scene: 笔身上一个漏气般的小电荷慢慢溜走
shots.prompt_en: Tiny charge dots slowly leak out of the pen body. No people.
shots.narration: 它会慢慢漏电，自己掉读数。

shots.scene: 阿杰上岗前把剂量计放到充电座上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places his pen dosimeter on the charger before starting work.
shots.narration: 所以每次用前都要重新充电归零。

shots.scene: 低能β粒子图标被挡在笔外，中子图标打问号
shots.prompt_en: A low-energy beta particle icon stops at the pen wall, and a neutron icon has a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 对低能β不灵敏，对中子反应差。

shots.scene: 天平：一边是闪电和对勾，一边是警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale: one side holds a lightning bolt with a green check, the other side holds a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 笔形剂量计，有长处也有短处。

shots.scene: 防护墙后的短时操作，工作人员随时看剂量计
shots.prompt_en: Behind a protective wall, the older man performs a short task with long tongs and glances at his pen dosimeter.
shots.narration: 长处：短时高风险作业，随时看读数。

shots.scene: 一盒结实便宜的剂量计，可以人手一支
shots.prompt_en: A box full of identical sturdy pen dosimeters, ready to hand out. No people.
shots.narration: 结实、便宜，可以大量配发。

shots.scene: 读数偏低的笔旁打红色警示，旁边一本空白档案被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pen dosimeter with a falsely low reading and a red warning mark, next to a blank record book crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 短处：会漏电虚低，不留永久记录。

shots.scene: 昏暗房间里，看不清目镜的笔
shots.prompt_en: A pen dosimeter in a dim room, its eyepiece too dark to read. No people.
shots.narration: 光线不够，还读不了数。

shots.scene: 五种剂量计并排：笔、胶片盒、小晶片卡、薄片卡、电子小盒
shots.prompt_en: Five personal dosimeters in a row: a pen, a film badge holder, a small chip card, a thin strip card and a small electronic unit with a blank screen. No people.
shots.narration: 个人剂量计不止一种。

shots.scene: 胶片、热释光、光释光三种送往实验室读出
shots.prompt_en: The film badge, the chip card and the strip card travel on a conveyor into a lab reader box. No people.
shots.narration: 胶片、热释光、光释光，要送去读出。

shots.scene: 这三种旁边一个上锁的档案柜
shots.prompt_en: Next to these three dosimeters, a locked filing cabinet with blank folders. No people.
shots.narration: 它们留下记录，用于长期存档。

shots.scene: 电子剂量计数字屏亮起，发出报警波纹
shots.prompt_en: The small electronic dosimeter lights up its blank digital screen and emits alarm ripples. No people.
shots.narration: 电子剂量计实时显示，还能报警。

shots.scene: 笔形剂量计和档案柜之间连线
shots.prompt_en: A line linking the pen dosimeter to the filing cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 即时控制和长期存档，要配合使用。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现房间和人形两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside two floating icons: a room and a human figure.
shots.narration: 测环境用巡测仪，测个人用剂量计。

shots.scene: 盖革和电离室图标，一个放大镜一个天平
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a counter with a magnifying glass and a chamber meter with a balance scale. No people.
shots.narration: 盖革灵敏找污染，电离室准确测剂量率。

shots.scene: 敲门、收银台、中子小球三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a knocking door, a busy cashier and a bouncing neutron ball. No people.
shots.narration: 记住盖革的三个局限。

shots.scene: 检定标签和能量刻度条图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank calibration sticker and an energy scale bar. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器要对所测的能量校准。

shots.scene: 笔形剂量计、档案柜和电子剂量计图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pen dosimeter, a filing cabinet and an electronic dosimeter. No people.
shots.narration: 即时读数和长期存档，配合使用。

shots.scene: 笔形剂量计插在充电座上
shots.prompt_en: A pen-shaped dosimeter standing in a small charger base. No people.
shots.narration: 笔形剂量计即时读，用前先充电。

shots.scene: 欣欣胸前别着剂量计，手提巡测仪挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a dosimeter badge on its chest, holds a survey meter and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 测得准，戴得对，安全心里有数！
